SC-2025-H5126.title: Budget
SC-2025-H5126.summary: AN ACT TO MAKE APPROPRIATIONS AND TO PROVIDE REVENUES TO MEET THE ORDINARY EXPENSES OF STATE GOVERNMENT FOR THE FISCAL YEAR BEGINNING JULY 1, 2026, TO REGULATE THE EXPENDITURE OF SUCH FUNDS, AND TO FURTHER PROVIDE FOR THE OPERATION OF STATE GOVERNMENT DURING THIS FISCAL YEAR AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES. - ratified title
SC-2025-H5126.summarySource: South Carolina legislature, description (via Open States)

Conference committee appointed Peeler, Hutto, Davis

SC-2025-H5126.aiSummary: The act sets the state budget for the fiscal year starting July 1, 2026. It provides money for ordinary state government costs, controls how those funds are spent, and covers how state government will operate during that year and other related matters. It became Act No. 259, and some items were vetoed by the governor.

SC-2025-S1162.title: Anderson County School District No. 2
SC-2025-S1162.summary: AN ACT TO AMEND ACT 509 OF 1982, AS AMENDED, RELATING TO THE ELECTION OF TRUSTEES OF ANDERSON COUNTY SCHOOL DISTRICT 2, SO AS TO PROVIDE THAT SIX MEMBERS OF THE SEVEN-MEMBER GOVERNING BODY MUST BE ELECTED FROM SINGLE-MEMBER DISTRICTS. - RATIFIED TITLE

SC-2025-S1162.aiSummary: The law changes how trustees for Anderson County School District 2 are chosen. It says six of the seven board members must be elected from single-member districts, meaning each one is elected from a separate area. It took effect on May 18, 2026.
